edges.label: Bennewitz's 1979-1980 observations were of the Manzano area of Kirtland AFB
edges.note: Bennewitz dated his personally funded study to July 1979, filmed lights and recorded signals over the base, contacted Kirtland on 24 October 1980 and briefed base officials on 10 November 1980. Attested by his own correspondence and contemporary press.

edges.label: Doty's AFOSI detachment ran the Bennewitz deception from Kirtland
edges.note: Richard C. Doty, an AFOSI special agent at Kirtland, has said publicly he was tasked in the 1980s with hoaxing documents and feeding false information to UFO researchers including Bennewitz. A 1992 article held in the CIA library names Doty and William Moore.
